title: Choose twodb's visual world
question: This choice becomes the design system in packages/ui — every note, chat, automation, and app in twodb will speak it. The roll assigned The Card Box. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or steer.

options.label: The Card Box
options.lineage: The index-card box (zettelkasten) — the original second brain
options.thesis: Everything in twodb is a card: notes, chats, automations, apps — filed, tabbed, and linked like a well-kept card box.
options.viewport: A calm card index: tabbed divider rail on the left, one open card at reading measure, hairlines instead of shadows.
options.risk: Reads plain if the tabs, stock, and hairline discipline are executed timidly.

options.label: Typographic Tiles
options.lineage: flat metro tile screens, giant lowercase type
options.thesis: Chrome deleted: color fields and type alone are the interface.
options.case: Coherent grammar, but cropped giant type fights condensed-calm legibility for this audience.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.lineage: early dithered desktop, window chrome, marching ants
options.thesis: A two-color pixel desktop where every note is a window.
options.case: Delightfully complete system, but this audience never met it — nostalgia they don't share.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: stage lighting: night to day along one horizon
options.thesis: Light alone structures the space, from black night to white day.
options.case: Beautiful and calm-adjacent, but atmosphere-as-navigation obscures the task at hand.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The Notion-grade neutral workhorse UI, played completely straight.
canonCard.viewport: Cool-white surfaces, gray sidebar, Inter-like type, 8px corners — familiar from minute one.
canonCard.risk: Instantly familiar; indistinguishable from every neighboring tool.
